# NotchMuse

> NotchMuse is a free, lightweight native Swift/AppKit macOS app that displays live synced lyrics around the MacBook notch, in the menu bar, or as a click-through floating desktop overlay. No account or login is required.

## Core Facts

- **Price & Account**: Free to download and use; no account or login required.
- **System Requirements**: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon Macs (M1 series or later; Intel Macs are not supported).
- **Supported Players**: Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, and Soda Music desktop apps on macOS (via macOS Now Playing / MediaRemote and Automation where prompted).
- **Display Modes**:
  - **Notch Mode**: Dynamic Island–style synced lyrics around the MacBook notch or positioned above the Dock.
  - **Status Bar Mode**: Compact scrolling lyrics in the macOS menu bar (left-side layout uses Accessibility permission).
  - **Floating Overlay**: Click-through, freely positionable desktop overlay with position lock, color presets, opacity, width, and animation speed controls.
- **Lyrics Sync**: Displays synchronized lyrics from public lyric sources, including word-timed progression when the source provides it.
- **Privacy**: The macOS app does not read or upload audio and requires no account. Track metadata (such as title and artist) may be sent to third-party lyric providers to fetch matching lyrics.
- **Trademark Notice**: Dynamic Island and MacBook are trademarks of Apple Inc. NotchMuse is an independent utility and is not affiliated with Apple.
- **Latest Download**: https://github.com/Xiye88/NotchMuse/releases/latest
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Xiye88/NotchMuse
- **Support**: support@notchmuse.com

## English Pages

- [NotchMuse Home](https://notchmuse.com/): Product overview, live macOS recordings, installation steps, and FAQ.
- [Menu Bar Lyrics for Mac](https://notchmuse.com/menu-bar-lyrics/): Setup, placement, width, and permissions for Status Bar Mode.
- [Spotify Lyrics on Mac](https://notchmuse.com/spotify-lyrics-mac/): Live synced Spotify lyrics in the menu bar, notch, or floating overlay.
- [Apple Music Desktop Lyrics for Mac](https://notchmuse.com/apple-music-desktop-lyrics-mac/): Comparing Apple Music built-in lyrics, MiniPlayer, and NotchMuse overlay modes.
- [MacBook Notch Lyrics](https://notchmuse.com/macbook-notch-lyrics/): Placing synced lyrics around the MacBook notch or above the Dock.
- [Mac Dynamic Island–Style Lyrics](https://notchmuse.com/mac-dynamic-island-lyrics/): Dynamic Island–style lyric companion around the MacBook notch for Apple silicon Macs.
- [Floating Lyrics for Mac](https://notchmuse.com/floating-lyrics-mac/): Click-through, always-above-regular-windows desktop lyric overlay with position lock.
- [LyricsX Alternative for macOS 14+](https://notchmuse.com/lyricsx-alternative/): Neutral comparison of documented features and Apple silicon macOS 14+ support.
- [NetEase Cloud Music Lyrics for Mac](https://notchmuse.com/netease-cloud-music-lyrics-mac/): Synced desktop and menu bar lyrics for the NetEase Cloud Music Mac desktop app.
- [QQ Music Lyrics for Mac](https://notchmuse.com/qq-music-lyrics-mac/): Synced lyrics for the QQ Music Mac desktop app via macOS Now Playing.
- [Soda Music Lyrics for Mac](https://notchmuse.com/soda-music-lyrics-mac/): Synced lyrics for the Soda Music Mac desktop app in Notch or Status Bar Mode.
